bagPolicy.summary: Bags smaller than 10" x 6" x 2" or clear bags smaller than 14" x 14" x 6" are allowed. Backpacks and luggage are never allowed.
allowed: Clear bags smaller than 14" x 14" x 6"
Non-clear bags up to 14" x 14" x 6" after x-ray screening
Diaper bags up to 14" x 14" x 6"
bagPolicy.note: Non-clear bags larger than 10" x 6" x 2", medical bags and diaper bags go through the designated bag screening lanes. Some events add extra bag restrictions, so check the event page. No bag check is listed.

parking.note: The 5th Street Parking Structure is open 24/7 and offers ADA parking spaces and EV charging stations. Oversized vehicles have limited parking options, and monthly rates are available for long-term parking.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Fiserv Forum's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Fiserv Forum introduces new food and beverage options for the 2024-25 season, including an upgraded Jameson bar and unique menu items like the MKE Burger and Greek Burger. Fans can also enjoy new dessert offerings and a variety of tacos and nachos in the suites.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Fiserv Forum, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Guests who leave Fiserv Forum during an event after their ticket has been scanned are not allowed to re-enter without an unused/unscanned ticket.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Phillips Avenue Milwaukee, Wisconsin 53203 Ticketmaster Box Office #: (414) 227-0511 Hours: The Ticketmaster Box Office is open on event days. Fans may redeem gift cards for Milwaukee Bucks tickets and tickets to most concerts and shows at the Ticketmaster Box Office during regular business hours, Fiserv Forum concessions stands, Bucks Pro Shop at Fiserv Forum, retail locations during Milwaukee Bucks games, and online at shop.bucks.com.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Fiserv Forum. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
